profileName: Pure positional PID / v54 settling+overshoot BayesOpt / 0-3 PID cube / fixed outbound setup / 0.001 grid / 300-degree / 5s cutoff

setupAssist.purpose: setup-only breakaway bumps when the fixed setup PID is stalled; never active during candidate TEST_RETURN

scoreObjective.purpose: diagnostic ranking only; not used as a JMP Bayesian response

dataPolicy.duplicateRoundedPidPolicy: replace an already-tested rounded PID with the nearest untested 0.001-grid neighbor
dataPolicy.returnFailureResponse: retained as a diagnostic column only; not used as a JMP Bayesian response
dataPolicy.homeReachedPolicy: Home Reached remains a diagnostic only and is not a JMP Bayesian response
dataPolicy.settlingTimePolicy: Settling Time ends only after five consecutive 100 Hz samples are stationary inside HomePad; unsuccessful returns are 5.0 s
dataPolicy.homePaddingPolicy: PID target remains exactly Home=0; HomePad is measurement/pass tolerance only and never changes candidate PID output
dataPolicy.fixedSetupPolicy: every outbound 300-degree setup and post-trial recovery uses fixedSetupPID 1.35/0.4/0.1; setup-only 100-PWM breakaway pulses may assist a stalled setup; only candidate Kp Ki Kd vary in Bayesian Optimization
dataPolicy.candidateControlPolicy: pure positional PID at 100 Hz: u=Kp*error+Ki*integral-Kd*measured_position_velocity; no minimum PWM floor, no near-home taper, no deadband, no integral enable band, no integral bleed, no separate integral-output cap, and no coast-on-settle override during TEST_RETURN
dataPolicy.firmwareTraceabilityPolicy: every v54 physical trial must identify as DiscoveryPID pure-positional-pid-v4.0 2026-08-21; stale firmware is rejected before motion
dataPolicy.seedDesignPolicy: four seeds retain the prior fastest basin, two local bracketing points, and one robust high-D completion basin; v54 models only settling time and overshoot
dataPolicy.failedTrialPolicy: unsuccessful returns receive Settling Time=5.0 s; measured Overshoot is retained so failures cannot look fast
